# #226 Replace list shows every relevant exercise for a muscle
## Parent
#224
## What to build
The muscle-filtered Replace list in the workout logger is ranked by relevance, with display-named staples first, instead of by name length with a cap that hides longer names. A player replacing a lats exercise sees the lat pulldowns.
## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Opening Replace for a lats exercise lists the lat pulldown variants (2330, 150) near the top - [ ] Display-named staples rank ahead of other rows for the same muscle; the result is not ordered by name length - [ ] No relevant row is dropped because of the result limit - [ ] A thin endpoint test covers the ranking and limit of the exercise search the logger calls
